vulnerability.name: USN-5510-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5510-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in X.Org. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Jan-Niklas Sohn discovered that the X.Org X Server incorrectly handled  certain inputs. An attacker could use this issue to cause the server to  crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary  code and escalate privileges.

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in X.Org X Server. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
